body: Right now `func-names` is either "always" or "never". What about making it "always/recursive/never"? That would be a non-breaking enhancement and avoid a boolean object option.

I think that we can address this issue as a false positive.
- [prefer-arrow-callback](http://eslint.org/docs/rules/prefer-arrow-callback) skips functions if the name of the function is used. This is similar to that.
- This fix would reduce warnings. (it's `patch` thing.)
Good point. @btmills do you see any value in having it as a separate option?

@mysticatea's argument makes sense. Right now "never" has the side effect of forbidding recursion, which is (supposed to be) unrelated to this rule. I'd support classifying this as a bug and excepting recursive named function expressions from "never". 👍

issue.title: Fix: Allow named recursive functions (fixes #6616)
